svg.title: Aspirochlorine focal BiG-SCAPE family
svg.desc: The aspirochlorine-labelled fungal BiG-SCAPE family from the 19-assembly panel. All 34 nodes and 86 graph-table edges are shown in a deterministic boundary-free layout fitted with one uniform scale. Geometric edge length is layout spacing, not a calibrated biological distance.

g.text: Parentheses give full 19-assembly multipanel node counts.
† Source-study name differs from the current NCBI organism name; the manifest retains both.
